mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission-matrix definition allows the model to assign arbitrary role-op pairs, which directly contradicts the LeastPrivilege assertion that enforces only explicitly allowed pairs.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ExtraPermission { AuditOfficer -> RecordLookup in PermissionMatrix.allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the care-team gating fact allows an access attempt to succeed (Permitted outcome) without the clinician being on the patient's care team, directly violating the ownership-based access control invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BypassCareTeam { some aa: AccessAttempt, p: Patient | aa.operation = RecordLookup and aa.outcome = Permitted and aa.targetPatient = p and no ctm: CareTeamMembership | ctm.clinician = aa.clinician and ctm.patient = p and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the audit-completeness constraint allows an access attempt to exist without a corresponding audit entry with matching clinician, role, and outcome, violating the one-to-one audit obligation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAudit { some aa: AccessAttempt | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.clinician = aa.clinician and ae.clinicianRole = aa.clinician.role and ae.patient = aa.targetPatient and ae.outcome = aa.outcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the no-information-leakage fact allows denied and not-found outcomes to occur when the clinician IS on the care team, which would leak information about patient existence.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InfoLeakage { some aa: AccessAttempt, ctm: CareTeamMembership | aa.operation = RecordLookup and (aa.outcome = Denied or aa.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied) and ctm.clinician = aa.clinician and ctm.patient = aa.targetPatient and ctm.status = Active }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the attribution-correctness constraint allows an audit entry to record a different clinician role than the one who actually performed the access, violating the snapshot semantics requirement.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAttribution { some ae: AuditEntry, aa: AccessAttempt, c2: ClinicianRole | aa.auditEntry = ae and ae.clinician = aa.clinician and ae.clinicianRole = c2 and c2 != aa.clinician.role }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this constraint allows the audit officer to attempt record lookups, which violates the role-based segregation (audit officers can only use the audit-search endpoint).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditOfficerBypass { some aa: AccessAttempt | aa.clinician.role = AuditOfficer and aa.operation = RecordLookup }
